description: Add and/or remove photos on one of the USER'S OWN existing listings (max 6 total). First call request_image_upload for each new image and upload the bytes, then pass the returned keys in `add`. Adding any image re-triggers AI moderation — the listing returns to 'pending' until the new images are cleared; removing images does not. Free (no credit).

add.description: Image keys from request_image_upload to attach (upload the bytes first). Each newly-added image is AI-moderated with the listing, so the listing returns to "pending" until cleared. Max 6 images total on a listing. Example: ["7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7"].

listing_id.description: Listing id, taken from the `id` field of search_listings, semantic_search or list_my_listings results. Example: "adzuna-us-5947308680".

remove.description: Image keys currently on the listing to detach. Removing alone does not trigger moderation. Example: ["7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7"].

name: update_listing_images
